name: Anyscale
short: Ray-powered AI compute platform offering distributed inference and fine-tuning with developer trial credits.

plans.name: Trial Credits
plans.notes: $100 trial credit granted on account creation. Generates API keys to test OpenAI-compatible serverless endpoints or launch Ray clusters in your own environment.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go / BYOC
plans.notes: Metered Ray node-hours or serverless per-token inference. Supports Bring-Your-Own-Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) deployments.
